tengwang_pavilion.name: Tengwang Pavilion
tengwang_pavilion.hours: Roughly 08:00–18:00; evening light show hours vary — check on the day
tengwang_pavilion.tip: Climb to the top floor for river views, then stay for the evening illumination if you can.

bayi_square.name: Bayi Square
bayi_square.tip: The city's central plaza and metro hub — a good orientation point and evening stroll.

bayi_night_market.name: Bayi Night Market food street
bayi_night_market.hours: Evening into late night; stalls vary
bayi_night_market.tip: Come hungry and try Jiangxi rice noodles (banfen) and spicy snacks from a few stalls.

jiangxi_museum.name: Jiangxi Provincial Museum
jiangxi_museum.price_text: Free with ID registration (check on the day)
jiangxi_museum.hours: Closed Mondays typically; roughly 09:00–17:00 — check on the day
jiangxi_museum.tip: Bring your passport for entry and focus on the regional history and porcelain galleries.

wanshou_palace.name: Wanshou Palace historic block
wanshou_palace.price_text: Free to walk; small fees for some halls
wanshou_palace.tip: Wander the restored lanes for old-style architecture, teahouses and local snacks.

ganjiang_river_walk.name: Ganjiang River waterfront walk
ganjiang_river_walk.tip: Walk the riverside promenade near Tengwang Pavilion at dusk for skyline and bridge views.

qingshanhu_park.name: Qingshanhu Lake Park
qingshanhu_park.tip: A calm lakeside escape with paths and greenery — good for a slow morning walk.

honggutan_riverside.name: Honggutan riverside promenade
honggutan_riverside.tip: Cross to the new-bank side for wide river views back toward the old city at night.

youmin_temple.name: Youmin Temple
youmin_temple.price_text: Small entry fee — check on the day
youmin_temple.tip: A quiet working temple in the city centre; dress modestly and keep voices low.

banfen_lunch.name: Jiangxi rice noodle lunch stop
banfen_lunch.tip: Nanchang banfen with peanut and chilli is the local staple — order it mild if unsure.

city_walk_old_town.name: Old town lane walk
city_walk_old_town.tip: Explore the small streets between the square and the river for everyday local life.

meiling.name: Meiling scenic area day trip
meiling.price_text: ≈ CNY 40–80 entry, transport extra — check on the day
meiling.hours: Daytime; last entry in the afternoon
meiling.tip: Hills and forest west of the city — go early and check transport back before you set out.

tengwang_show.name: Tengwang Pavilion evening light show
tengwang_show.price_text: Often free to watch from outside; ticketed shows vary — check on the day
tengwang_show.tip: Arrive early for a spot by the river; confirm show times locally as they change.

babaoshan.name: Babaoshan area stroll
babaoshan.tip: A low-key green corner for a quiet break between sights — check access on the day.

metro_day.name: Metro day pass and city hopping
metro_day.tip: The metro links the square, river and lake areas — buy single rides or a stored-value card.

porcelain_shop.name: Jiangxi porcelain and craft shops
porcelain_shop.tip: Jiangxi is known for porcelain — browse before buying and compare prices.

riverside_breakfast.name: Local breakfast stall morning
riverside_breakfast.tip: Start early with steamed buns and soy milk where locals eat before work.

night_river_cruise.name: Ganjiang night boat ride
night_river_cruise.tip: Confirm departure point and price at the dock; views of the lit pavilion are the highlight.

temple_market.name: Neighbourhood wet market visit
temple_market.tip: Go before 09:00 to see the freshest produce and busiest local life.

honggutan_park.name: Honggutan wetland park walk
honggutan_park.tip: Quiet paths along the water on the new-bank side — bring water and sun protection.
